description: This file defines the Drupal Core FormBuilder class responsible for building, processing, caching, and handling forms within the Drupal CMS. It includes methods for form retrieval, validation, submission, cache management, and rendering helpers, as well as handling CSRF tokens and form element processing.

classes.name: FormBuilder
classes.description: Provides form building and processing within Drupal, including form retrieval, validation, submission, cache management, and rendering helpers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as validators, cache, module handler, event dispatcher, request stack, class resolver, element info, theme manager, CSRF token generator, and callable resolver.

methods.name: isElementAccessible
methods.description: Checks if a form element is accessible based on its #access property.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Determines the form ID from a form object or class, setting it in the form state.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds a form instance with given arguments.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Main method to build and process a form, handling cache, AJAX, and form processing pipeline.

methods.name: rebuildForm
methods.description: Rebuilds a form, optionally using a previous form as a template.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached form data by form build ID.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores form data in cache with a form build ID.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Deletes cached form data by form build ID.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, validation, and processing.

methods.name: retrieveForm
methods.description: Retrieves the form structure by form ID, calling the form's buildForm method.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Processes form input, validation, submission, and handles AJAX responses.

methods.name: prepareForm
methods.description: Prepares form structure, including CSRF tokens, form ID, theme, and hooks.

methods.name: doBuildForm
methods.description: Builds individual form elements, applying defaults, handling input, and recursive child processing.

methods.name: renderPlaceholderFormAction
methods.description: Renders a placeholder for form action URL.

methods.name: renderFormTokenPlaceholder
methods.description: Renders a placeholder for CSRF token.

methods.name: buildFormAction
methods.description: Builds the form's action URL, considering current request and HTMX requests.

methods.name: setInvalidTokenError
methods.description: Sets an invalid CSRF token error in form validation.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Delegates form validation to the form validator service.

methods.name: redirectForm
methods.description: Handles form redirection after submission.

methods.name: executeValidateHandlers
methods.description: Executes validation handlers for the form.

methods.name: executeSubmitHandlers
methods.description: Executes submit handlers for the form.

methods.name: doSubmitForm
methods.description: Placeholder method to be replaced by processForm; throws exception if called directly.

methods.name: doBuildForm
methods.description: Builds individual form elements, applying defaults, handling input, and recursive child processing.

methods.name: valueCallableIsSafe
methods.description: Checks if a value callback is safe to run with an invalid CSRF token.

methods.name: handleInputElement
methods.description: Prepares input element #name and #value, handles disabled and access restrictions, and sets validation flags.

methods.name: elementTriggeredScriptedSubmission
methods.description: Detects if an element triggered form submission via Ajax or script.

methods.name: buttonWasClicked
methods.description: Determines if a button element was clicked to submit the form.

methods.name: getFileUploadMaxSize
methods.description: Returns maximum upload size based on PHP environment settings.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current active user account.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of callback functions considered safe for trusted execution.
